preconditions.description: The length of the array n must be between 3 and 5000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 10**5 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: All elements of the array a must be positive integers not exceeding 100000.

postconditions.description: The output array must have the same length as the input n.

postconditions.expression: all(a[i] == a[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The output array must contain the correct elements of the guessed array.
